people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: Yahweh appeared to him, and said, “Don’t go down into Egypt. Live in the land I will tell you about.
translations.bsb: The LORD appeared to Isaac and said, “Do not go down to Egypt. Settle in the land where I tell you.
